description: EDGE_PROCESS steps 5-7 for one deployment at stage forward, and on through live: every new session, once the lake holds its day, replayed with the deployment's frozen parameters through the exact code that searched it (the search job's own image), and recorded in the forward ledger with the files read and the image revision. The database counts the sessions toward forward_sessions_observed and refuses one before the forward start, not over yet, or more than 10 days late. After each session the database judges the record against the experiment's holdout (fks 030: the forward band once the declared window is in, a CUSUM throughout) and retires the deployment on a breach; the runner then goes idle (alert EdgeDeploymentRetired: stop it). Paper only: it trades nothing.
